Name: Mini MP Configuration (CONFIGURATION)
Label: Mini MP Configuration
Description: User Configured, or one of the four Standard Variants.

Name: mA Output (MA_OUTPUT)
Label: mA Output
Description: Single or dual mA output, derived from the measurements.

Name: Measurement 1 (MEASUREMENT_1)
Label: Measurement 1
Description: Primary measurement: an oxygen cell or a CO2 range.

Name: Probe Holder (PROBE_HOLDER)
Label: Probe Holder
Description: Probe holder, derived from the side panel.

Name: Sample Probe (SAMPLE_PROBE)
Label: Sample Probe
Description: Optional sample probe, selectable only with a probe holder.

Name: Side Panel Accessories (SIDE_PANEL_ACCESSORIES)
Label: Side Panel Accessories
Description: Optional side panel: sample conditioning panel or flow meter.

Name: Supply Power (SUPPLY_POWER)
Label: Supply Power
Description: Mains supply region, or a rechargeable battery for that region.

Name: Transport Case (TRANSPORT_CASE)
Label: Transport Case
Description: Transport case; supplied by default with a side panel.
